question.text: What is the minimum investment amount for an Infrastructure Debt Scheme of a mutual fund?

explanation.text: The Logic: Infrastructure Debt Schemes require a minimum investment of Rs. 1 crore, with a minimum face value per unit of Rs. 10 lakh. They are closed-ended with a tenor of at least five years, invest at least 90 percent in specified infrastructure securities, disclose NAV quarterly, and are listed on a stock exchange. The Trap: Rs. 1 crore is the minimum investment; lower amounts such as Rs. 1 lakh or Rs. 10 lakh are not permitted under this scheme category. Note: Liquidity comes from the closed-ended tenor and the stock-exchange listing rather than from open-ended redemptions.
